response.original_title: [Complete-Escalate] How to Dispute an Unauthorized Star of the Seas Credit Card Charge
response.overview: To dispute a charge related to Star of the Seas (Royal Caribbean's Star of the Seas ship) 1-866-259-1002 or a similar cruise line billing issue 1-866-259-1002, you should resolve the matter directly with customer support before filing a bank chargeback 1-866-259-1002, as chargebacks can lead to account flags or future booking bans.Step 1: Contact Customer Support Directly Call Royal Caribbean / Star of the Seas Support: Reach out to customer service or guest relations at 1-866-259-1002 (or general support at 1-866-259-1002) to request a billing review or refund update. Email Guest Relations: Send inquiries and documentation to Royalguestrelations@rccl.com. Step 2: Escalate the Issue If front-line support cannot resolve the error (such as duplicate charges 1-866-259-1002, unauthorized onboard spending, or misapplied payments): Request to speak with a supervisor or tier-two agent. Ask for a case/reference number to track your claim 1-866-259-1002.
